theme: 教材字彙・進階 650–750 第 32 群

items.colloc: speak politely 有禮貌地說話 | ask politely 客氣地詢問
items.distinct: courteously 謙恭地 | respectfully 恭敬地
ex: He politely declined the client's offer.
他有禮貌地婉拒了客戶的提議。
The receptionist greeted the guests politely.
接待員很有禮貌地向賓客問好。
Please ask the staff politely for assistance.
請客氣地向員工尋求協助。

items.pos: n. 要求 | v. 請求
items.colloc: make a request 提出要求 | at the request of 應...之要求
items.distinct: demand 強烈要求 | appeal 呼籲
ex: Management denied the request for a raise.
管理層拒絕了加薪的要求。
The manager requested a detailed project report.
經理要求一份詳細的專案報告。
We submitted the request before the deadline.
我們在截止日期前提交了請求。

items.colloc: set sail 啟航 | smooth sailing 順利進行
items.distinct: navigate 導航 | voyage 長途航行
ex: The luxury cruise ship will sail tonight.
這艘豪華郵輪將於今晚啟航。
They plan to sail across the Pacific Ocean.
他們計畫航行橫跨太平洋。
The cargo ship set sail on schedule.
這艘貨輪準時啟航了。

items.colloc: short notice 短時間通知 | fall short 未達標準
items.distinct: brief 簡短的 | concise 簡潔的
ex: We are short of supplies for the event.
活動所需的物資我們不足。
The meeting was short and very productive.
會議很短且非常有成效。
He was hired on short notice.
他在很短的通知下被錄用了。

items.colloc: thoroughly enjoyed 徹底享受 | check thoroughly 徹底檢查
items.distinct: completely 完全地 | entirely 完全地
ex: The inspector thoroughly examined the equipment.
檢查員徹底檢查了設備。
We must prepare thoroughly for the presentation.
我們必須為簡報做徹底的準備。
The policy was thoroughly discussed by the board.
董事會徹底討論了這項政策。

items.pos: v. 開始 | n. 開端
items.colloc: start a business 創業 | get a head start 先發優勢
items.distinct: commence 開始（較正式） | initiate 發起
ex: The training session will start at nine.
培訓課程將於九點開始。
She decided to start her own consulting firm.
她決定創業成立自己的諮詢公司。
Let us start the meeting without further delay.
我們別再拖延，開始會議吧。

items.pos: n. 洪水 | v. 淹沒
items.colloc: flood damage 洪水損害 | flood of orders 大量訂單
items.distinct: overflow 溢出 | inundate 淹沒（正式）
ex: Heavy rain caused a flood in the warehouse.
大雨導致倉庫淹水。
The office was flooded with customer complaints.
辦公室充斥著客戶的抱怨。
Excessive water may flood the production area.
過多的水可能會淹沒生產區。

items.pos: n. 貿易 | v. 進行交易
items.colloc: international trade 國際貿易 | trade fair 貿易展
items.distinct: commerce 商業 | business 生意
ex: The two countries increased their bilateral trade.
兩國增加了雙邊貿易往來。
They trade agricultural goods with neighboring nations.
他們與鄰國進行農產品交易。
The annual trade fair attracts many buyers.
年度貿易展吸引了許多買家。

items.colloc: run a company 經營公司 | in good company 有好夥伴
items.distinct: firm 商號 | corporation 大型企業
ex: She works for a major technology company.
她在一家大型科技公司工作。
The company is expanding its global reach.
這家公司正在擴展其全球影響力。
He enjoys the company of his colleagues.
他喜歡與同事們為伍。

items.pos: prep. 在...裡面 | adv. 在室內
items.colloc: inside information 內線消息 | inside the box 在框內
items.distinct: within 在...之內 | interior 內部的
ex: Please wait inside the lobby until called.
請在在大廳內等候直到被叫到。
The documents are inside the locked drawer.
文件在鎖住的抽屜裡面。
It is much warmer inside the building.
大樓內部溫暖多了。

items.colloc: proof of purchase 購買證明 | demand proof 要求證明
items.distinct: evidence 證據（法律） | testimony 證詞
ex: You need proof of identity to enter.
進入時你需要身份證明。
We have no proof that the deal failed.
我們沒有證據證明該交易失敗了。
Please provide proof of your previous experience.
請提供你過去經驗的證明。

items.colloc: successfully completed 成功完成 | successfully negotiated 成功談判
items.distinct: effectively 有效地 | victoriously 勝利地
ex: The team successfully launched the new software.
團隊成功推出了新軟體。
We have successfully met our quarterly goals.
我們已經成功達成季度目標。
He successfully managed the challenging project.
他成功地管理了這項具挑戰性的專案。

items.pos: v. 控制 | n. 管理
items.colloc: quality control 品質管制 | under control 在控制中
items.distinct: regulate 調節 | supervise 監督
ex: The manager has full control of the budget.
經理對預算有完全的控制權。
Strict quality control is essential for success.
嚴格的品質管制對成功至關重要。
We need to control the operating expenses.
我們需要控制營運成本。

items.colloc: curious about 對...好奇 | remain curious 保持好奇心
items.distinct: inquisitive 愛打聽的 | interested 感興趣的
ex: The investors were curious about the new strategy.
投資者對新策略感到好奇。
She is curious to learn how the system works.
她很想了解系統是如何運作的。
Employees are curious about the office relocation.
員工們對辦公室搬遷感到好奇。

items.colloc: fire alarm 火災警報 | get fired 被解雇
items.distinct: dismiss 解雇（較正式） | lay off 裁員
ex: The company had to fire several unproductive staff.
公司不得不解雇幾名生產力低落的員工。
An alarm went off during the fire drill.
消防演習期間警報響了。
You cannot fire someone without a reason.
你不能無緣無故解雇某人。

items.pos: v. 設定 | 放置 | n. 一組
items.colloc: set a date 設定日期 | set a goal 設定目標
items.distinct: place 放置 | establish 建立
ex: We need to set a meeting for Monday.
我們需要為週一設定一個會議。
The management set high goals for the quarter.
管理層為本季設定了高目標。
Please set the folders on my desk.
請把資料夾放在我的桌子上。

items.colloc: in fashion 時髦的 | fashion industry 時尚產業
items.distinct: style 風格 | trend 趨勢
ex: She works as a manager in the fashion industry.
她在時尚產業擔任經理。
The new design is currently very much in fashion.
這項新設計目前非常流行。
He handled the issue in a professional fashion.
他以專業的方式處理了這個問題。

items.colloc: construction site 施工現場 | website 網站
items.distinct: location 地點 | venue 場地
ex: The construction site is off-limits to visitors.
施工現場禁止訪客進入。
We are launching a new company website soon.
我們很快就要發布新的公司網站。
The proposed site is ideal for the factory.
提議的地點對工廠來說很理想。

items.pos: v. 等待 | n. 等候
items.colloc: wait for 等候 | wait in line 排隊
items.distinct: await 等待（較正式） | expect 預期
ex: We cannot wait for the final approval.
我們無法等待最終批准。
Please wait in the reception area for assistance.
請在接待區等候以獲得協助。
There is a long wait for the service.
這項服務需要排隊很久。

items.pos: n. 一份（食物） | v. 幫助（help的現在分詞）
items.colloc: a helping of 一份... | helping hand 援手
items.distinct: portion 部分；一份 | serving 一份
ex: He offered a second helping of the dessert.
他提供了第二份甜點。
She is currently helping with the marketing report.
她目前正在協助行銷報告。
Providing a helping hand builds strong teamwork.
伸出援手能建立強大的團隊合作。
